g.title: Qwen3Layer0Shard16
g.text: Qwen3-0.6B official Hugging Face layer graph mapped to nncase shard-16 Triton lowering
prefill S=39, batch=1, H=1024, I=3072, QH=16, KVH=8, D=128, PE=16

g.title: nn_q
g.text: ord6 CCL n0 materialize + ord7 q_proj + ord8 q_norm/transpose

g.title: nn_rope
g.text: ord9 position_ids; ord10 angle+cos; ord12 sin
ord11/13 CCL broadcast cos/sin for Q
ord14 q RoPE, ord19 k RoPE

g.title: nn_cache
g.text: ord20 K layout + ord21 update K cache

g.title: nn_o
g.text: ord24 transpose/cast + ord25 o_proj + ord26 CCL reduce-scatter

g.title: hf_next
g.text: then model.norm and lm_head after all 28 layers
